drafter.private_reasoning: This is a first draft, and the terms are very high-level. No problematic language is present, but key details are missing (salary, severance amount, benefits specifics). Although we are not obligated to propose detailed Employer-favorable language at this turn, it is reasonable and efficient for deal progress to suggest filling in these blanks and clarifying terms in a detailed but generally balanced manner to facilitate negotiation. Our relationship with Bellweather Croft LLP favors transparency and deal velocity, so we should keep tone collegiate and open-ended.

receiver.message_back: Thank you for your draft. We note your additions and are reviewing internally, but at this stage we expect to propose a severance period of six months’ base salary (excluding benefits), a maximum annual bonus cap of 10%, and a non-compete standard of six months limited to product lines directly managed by the Executive; please confirm if these prove workable from your client’s perspective while we further consider compensation figures.

drafter.private_reasoning: Their counter was anticipated and is reasonable—we can accept the six months severance, six month non-compete (with our prior carve-outs for scope/geography), and 10% max bonus. This improves client’s position by achieving closure on these key deal points within the expected market range, while not conceding on less negotiable elements. Making these changes and confirming their workability helps maintain positive momentum and trust in this deal, also mindful of our referrals relationship. I am aligning the language to their proposal, tightening terms as appropriate. I will note that we await their compensation feedback, encouraging further engagement but showing readiness to close on structure.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for your prompt and constructive feedback. We confirm that your proposed adjustments are workable for our client: six months’ base salary for severance (excluding benefits), a bonus cap of 10% per annum, and a non-compete duration of six months limited to product lines directly managed by the Executive, with existing carve-outs as previously drafted. We look forward to your further input regarding compensation figures and are prepared to finalize remaining details expeditiously.
